integrity: Exact finite identities follow from direct Rees multiplication and occupancy counts. Finite computational tests support, but do not prove, the asymptotic law. Multivariate Gaussian CLT establishes the limit; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Labeled uniform-entry Rees matrices over a fixed finite group; does not address zero entries, isomorphism-class sampling, or growth of group order or row number. Novelty assessment has residual unindexed-literature risk.
title: Universal chi-square fluctuations of idempotent-product density in random Rees matrix semigroups
